hero.name: AYUSHMAN
hero.headline: Open-Source Maintainer & DevRel Engineer
hero.subhead: GitHub Maintainer Advisory for Pollinations.ai · DevRel Engineer @ Myceli AI
hero.intro: I build the automation, release engineering, and developer tooling that keep large open-source projects running, contributor pipelines, CI/CD, and deployment infrastructure.

intro.description: I work across open-source maintainership, platform engineering, research, and developer communities. I care about systems that are understandable to contributors, dependable for users, and documented well enough for someone else to operate.

websiteSection.designedBy: This portfolio is part of the Elixpo project ecosystem and was built to keep my projects, talks, research, and community work in one public place. Its visual direction was inspired by Nicolo Miranda, with artwork from Elixpo Art.
websiteSection.futurePlans: I am continuing to grow this site as a record of what I build and learn. The next steps are deeper engineering notes, reproducible research artifacts, and clearer links between project source code, talks, and the operational lessons behind them.
websiteSection.codeStory: Elixpo began as a way for friends to build together during university. It has since grown into a collection of open-source services and experiments spanning search, identity, publishing, developer tooling, and creative applications. Vivek Yadav and Anwesha Chakraborty have contributed to that journey, along with the wider community that has tested, documented, and improved these projects.

techSection.heading: THE TECHY SYNAPSE
techSection.description: My current focus is platform engineering for open-source and AI products: CI/CD, containers, cloud deployment, Redis-backed systems, contributor automation, developer experience, and the boundaries between model output and application control. I learn these topics by building, operating, documenting, and then teaching the parts that failed or surprised me.
